title: PostBrain content brief
description: The plain-language input the Brain turns into a professional Instagram post. Only `headline` is required; everything else is optional and improves the result.

headline.description: The one big line. Keep it <= 8 words for poster impact.

eyebrow.description: Small kicker/category label shown above the headline, e.g. 'CASE STUDY'.

subtext.description: One supporting sentence. In a quote card this holds the attribution.

bullets.description: Provide these to get a numbered-list layout. Keep each <= 6 words.

stat.description: Provide to get the big-number 'stat spotlight' layout.

cta.description: Call-to-action pill text, e.g. 'Save this post'.

industry.description: Free text (fitness, saas, wellness, ai, food, event, ...). Steers palette + fonts.

mood.description: Optional explicit mood: bold, elegant, playful, minimal, premium, energetic, calm, ...

palette.description: Hard override. One of the palette ids in src/design-system/palettes.js.

layout.description: Hard override of the auto-selected layout.

pairing.description: Hard override. One of the font pairing ids in src/design-system/typography.js.

seed.description: Reproducibility knob. Same brief + seed => same design; change it to explore variations.
